topic: Phone camera sees rolling black bar on screens
hook: Your phone camera can show a black bar rolling down a screen.
title: Your Phone Camera Sees a Bar Screens Hide
description:
Point your phone camera at a laptop or TV and you may see a dark bar rolling down it. Screens redraw the picture many times a second, and your camera can catch that clash. It depends on the screen, so try a few.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Tech
comment_prompt: Did you see the black bar? Yes or no
